task.title: Partial overpayment (OP) write-off approved — Blocked or archived claim

step.cmd: Determine if there is an outstanding ASMT, CA or CR Recalculation WI pending the result of the write-off decision:

In NWS, create a client Note and type “partial write-off approved. When inputting the transactions, use message code [message code 65, 66, 67 or 68] for the portion of the OP that will be written off.” Go to step 26.
In FTS, determine if there is an outstanding registration number for the write-off issue:

ul.li:
If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if the BPCs of the affected claims can be updated in BCS by referring to the appropriate procedures and the input instructions in the AI WI sent by Level 1:

ul.li: If yes, complete the inputs in BCS and go to step 26.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim on which the OP occurred.
Earnings to be allocated: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 2: Enter the decision information for the period that will be written off using the appropriate OP codes (e.g. D1 2421-1 to 2430-5 31B 66 ).
Remarks line 3: Enter the decision information for the period that will not be written off (e.g. D1 2431-1 to 9999 31B 04 ).
Remarks line 5: Type your first name and your last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a WI for the write-off issue:

ul.li: If no, no further action is required.
